lines.en: label christmastwo7:
scene wintersky

This year’s Christmas party is taking place in the same exact hotel as the last one so, after finishing up at Sara’s, I catch a bus across town in an effort to give my body its own sort of Christmas present.
lines.zh: 今年的圣诞派对办在和去年一模一样的那家酒店，所以在 Sara 那边收工之后，我搭了辆公交横穿城区，算是给自己的身体也送上一份圣诞礼物。

lines.en: Being someone who doesn’t exactly enjoy exercising on even normal days of the week, I figure that today being Christmas should be enough of an excuse to at least exempt me for now.
lines.zh: 我这人本来平时就不怎么爱运动，心想既然今天是圣诞节，那好歹也够格让我暂时免掉这一遭。

lines.en: Besides, I spend enough of my normal days walking as-is.
lines.zh: 再说，我平时走路的时间本来就已经够多了。

lines.en: And I still need to find somewhere to buy Miku a present- a thing I have decided to do because ruining two Christmases in a row is a little {i}too{/i} on brand for me and I want to mix things up.
lines.zh: 而且我还得找个地方给 Miku 买礼物——之所以非得这么做，是因为连续毁掉两个圣诞节对我来说也{i}太{/i}“本色出演”了，我想换换花样。

lines.en: As such, I make my way into the first discount store I find and quickly begin perusing their varied selection of goods in hope of uncovering some sort of treasure a [teenage]girl might enjoy.
lines.zh: 于是我走进了碰到的第一家折扣店，迅速开始翻看他们五花八门的商品，希望能挖出点某个 [teenage]女孩会喜欢的好东西。

lines.en: If you ever find yourself Christmas shopping for someone you have a moderate amount of care for, I recommend bringing along a game plan- because things aren’t going too great for me right now.
lines.zh: 如果你哪天要给自己还算在乎的人买圣诞礼物，我建议你最好带着计划来——因为我现在的处境可不太妙。

lines.en: Originally, I thought I could just get off with buying a soccer ball or something- but I know for a fact that Miku already has like seven thousand of them.
lines.zh: 一开始我以为随便买个足球什么的就能糊弄过去，但我很清楚 Miku 已经有大概七千个足球了。

lines.en: Okay, maybe that’s an exaggerated fact- but I know damn well she has a lot.
lines.zh: 好吧，这个数字可能有点夸张——但我敢肯定她确实有一大堆。

lines.en: After searching around for nearly ten minutes and not being able to find {i}anything{/i}, I come across a rack of toys and stuffed animals clearly not meant for someone Miku’s age.
lines.zh: 找了快十分钟{i}一无所获{/i}之后，我撞见了一排玩具和毛绒玩偶，明摆着不是给 Miku 这个年纪的人准备的。

lines.en: However-
lines.zh: 然而——

lines.en: Miku is extremely immature and often acts like a real child, so this is enough to justify, at least in my head, purchasing something from this section of the store.
lines.zh: Miku 极其幼稚，经常表现得像个真正的小孩，所以这足以让——至少在我脑子里——从这一区买点东西变得名正言顺。

lines.en: I am sorry in advance to Miku, who may or may not think this potentially used stuffed bear is an adequate present.
lines.zh: 我先在这儿给 Miku 道个歉，因为她未必会觉得这只可能被用过的毛绒熊算得上像样的礼物。

lines.en: But, if you really think about it, any present is an adequate present when you’re not obligated to give someone something.
lines.zh: 但是，仔细想想，当你本来就没有义务送人东西的时候，任何礼物都算像样的礼物。

lines.en: So Miku should find solace in the fact that I went out of my way to do this rather than just leaving her with absolutely nothing.
lines.zh: 所以 Miku 应该从“我特意跑了一趟”这件事上得到安慰，而不是让她彻底一无所获。

lines.en: I think for a moment about getting something for Maya as well, seeing as she left the last party empty handed because of me.
lines.zh: 我也想了一下要不要给 Maya 也买点什么，毕竟上次派对她是因为我才两手空空地离开的。

lines.en: But then I remember that I bought her a scarf that she wears every day- so I have already been forgiven for that misdeed.
lines.zh: 但接着我想起来，我给她买过一条围巾，她天天戴着——所以那笔过错早就已经被原谅了。

lines.en: And it’s not like she’s ever bought anything for {i}me{/i}, so the idea of buying her anything at all is one that’s simply just taking up unnecessary space in my head.
lines.zh: 而且她也从来没给{i}我{/i}买过什么东西，所以“要不要给她买”这个念头纯粹是在我脑子里占地方。

lines.en: And I need all the space I can get right now, seeing as I am about to embark on yet another survival mission in trying to navigate a Christmas without tragedy.
lines.zh: 而我现在需要所有能腾出来的空间，因为我马上又要开启一场生存任务，试图平安度过一个没有惨剧的圣诞节。

lines.en: An entire school sunk into the ground last time.
lines.zh: 上次可是整整一所学校沉进了地里。

lines.en: I can only imagine what wonders await me this year.
lines.zh: 我真不敢想象今年还有什么“精彩节目”在等着我。

lines.en: scene black
scene welcometoxmastwo1
The first pair I encounter upon arriving is none other than Chika, dressed in the same outfit she wore to the last party, and Tsubasa, wearing...what she always wears.
lines.zh: 我到场后遇到的第一对，不是别人，正是穿着和上次派对同一套衣服的 Chika，以及穿着……她一贯那身打扮的 Tsubasa。

lines.en: I do notice the distinct lack of a demon clinging to her leg, though, so I guess her younger daughter stayed at home this year instead of-
lines.zh: 不过我确实注意到，这次没有小恶魔黏在她腿上了，所以我猜她的小女儿今年是留在家里了，而不是——

lines.en: Wait, why is Tsubasa even here?
lines.zh: 等等，Tsubasa 为什么会在这里？

lines.en: : Ahem.
lines.zh: : Ahem.

lines.en: scene welcometoxmastwo2
: Ah! Sensei! Merry Christmas!
lines.zh: : 啊！老师！圣诞快乐！

lines.en: : Merry Christmas. And thank you again for always taking care of my daughter.
lines.zh: : 圣诞快乐。还有，再次谢谢你一直照顾我女儿。

lines.en: scene welcometoxmastwo3
: Or {i}daughters{/i}, I suppose.
lines.zh: : 或者应该说，{i}女儿们{/i}。

lines.en: : Oh, stop. You don’t have to go that far.
lines.zh: : 哎呀，别这样。你不用说到这个份上。

lines.en: : Of course I know I don’t {i}have{/i} to, dear. But, honestly, you’re much more bearable than Tsukasa is. And she lived inside of me for nine months.
lines.zh: : 我当然知道{i}不用{/i}，亲爱的。但说实话，你比 Tsukasa 好相处多了。而我肚子里可是装了她九个月。

lines.en: : What are you doing here, if you don’t mind me asking?
lines.zh: : 恕我冒昧问一句，你在这里做什么？

lines.en: scene welcometoxmastwo2
: Tsubasa agreed to look after Chinami tonight so Yumi and I could come to the party!
lines.zh: : Tsubasa 答应今晚帮忙照看 Chinami，这样 Yumi 和我就能来参加派对了！

lines.en: : So Chinami is upstairs right now? Is that safe?
lines.zh: : 那 Chinami 现在就在楼上？那样安全吗？

lines.en: : She’s actually with Yumi at the moment, but they should be getting here soon. That’s why I’m waiting down here.
lines.zh: : 她这会儿其实和 Yumi 在一起，不过她们应该快到了。所以我才在楼下等着。

lines.en: : And {i}I’m{/i} waiting down here because I’m worried I may kill my youngest daughter tonight.
lines.zh: : 而{i}我{/i}之所以在楼下等着，是因为我担心自己今晚可能会把小女儿给杀了。

lines.en: scene welcometoxmastwo4
: That’s...yeah, okay.
lines.zh: : 这……好吧，嗯。

lines.en: : Are you sure you’re okay with watching Chinami, too? She’s a good girl, but...well, she’s never really been around anyone her age before. So she might wind up getting a little hyper.
lines.zh: : 你确定照看 Chinami 也没问题吗？她是个好孩子，不过……怎么说呢，她以前几乎没和同龄人待过。所以她可能会有点过于兴奋。

lines.en: : I’m sure it will be fine. Tsukasa’s spent most of her life in the manor, so she doesn’t have any experience with girls her age either.
lines.zh: : 我确定不会有事。Tsukasa 大半辈子都待在那座宅子里，所以她同样没什么和同龄女孩相处的经验。

lines.en: scene welcometoxmastwo5
: And I can assure you that I’ve made sure the room is properly sanitized and free of anything that could harm the poor girl. You have my word that your future sister-in-law will be safe in my hands.
lines.zh: : 而且我可以保证，我已经确认过房间彻底消过毒，没有任何可能伤害到那可怜女孩的东西。我向你保证，你未来的小姨子在我手里会很安全。

lines.en: scene imissyoumore
scene welcometoxmastwo6
: Sensei?
lines.zh: : 老师？

lines.en: : Yeah? What’s up?
lines.zh: : 嗯？怎么了？

lines.en: : You okay? You just froze up for a second.
lines.zh: : 你还好吗？你刚刚愣住了一瞬。

lines.en: : Hm? I’m fine.
lines.zh: : 嗯？我没事。

lines.en: : Anyway, have you seen Miku around? I have to give her this present thing.
lines.zh: : 话说回来，你看到 Miku 了吗？我得把这个“礼物”交给她。

lines.en: scene welcometoxmastwo7
: Oh, is {i}that{/i} who that’s for? I was wondering why you were just carrying a stuffed animal around.
lines.zh: : 哦，原来是给{i}她{/i}的？我还纳闷你为什么一直抱着个毛绒玩具到处走。

lines.en: : Aren’t you supposed to like, wrap it, though?
lines.zh: : 不过你不该把它包起来吗？

lines.en: : Chika, you should know by now that I never wrap anything.
lines.zh: : Chika，你到现在应该知道了，我从来不包任何东西。

lines.en: scene welcometoxmastwo8
: Oh my.
lines.zh: : 哎呀呀。

lines.en: : Wha- Sensei?!
: Really, though, have you seen her?
lines.zh: : 说真的，你到底见没见过她？

lines.en: scene welcometoxmastwo9
: I’m sure she’s upstairs with everyone else, but...I think we’re all doing the Secret Santa exchange as a group.
lines.zh: : 我猜她应该和别人一起在楼上，不过……我觉得大家是要一起搞 Secret Santa 交换。

lines.en: : Then what am I supposed to do with this unwrapped present? I can’t just stick it in the pile with all of the wrapped ones. People will know I’m the one who bought it.
lines.zh: : 那我这份没包装的礼物该怎么办？我总不能把它往一堆包好的礼物里一塞吧。大家会知道是我买的。

lines.en: : Well...I mean...you...kind of did that to yourself?
lines.zh: : 嗯……我是说……你……这不是自找的吗？

lines.en: Some {i}girlfriend{/i} you are.
lines.zh: 你算什么{i}女朋友{/i}。

lines.en: scene welcometoxmastwo10
: Chika darling, I’m going to head back upstairs before my daughter burns down the entire hotel. But feel free to bring Chinami up once your Yakuza friend arrives.
lines.zh: : Chika 亲爱的，我趁我女儿还没把整家酒店烧掉，先上楼去了。不过等你那位黑道朋友到了，随时把 Chinami 带上来就行。

lines.en: : Sounds good! Thanks again, Tsubasa! I’ll be sure to make it up to you sometime!
lines.zh: : 好的！再次谢谢你，Tsubasa！我改天一定好好报答你！

lines.en: scene welcometoxmastwo11
: And {i}you{/i} be sure to treat my surrogate daughter well. Especially if you’re so against {i}wrapping things.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你{/i}也要好好对待我那个“替补女儿”。尤其是你这么抵触{i}包装东西{/i}的情况下。

lines.en: : Oh, actually. On that note, can I ask you something?
lines.zh: : 啊，对了。说到这个，我能问你件事吗？

lines.en: scene welcometoxmastwo12
: What could you possibly have to ask her on that note?!
lines.zh: : 说到这个，你到底能有什么要问她的？！

lines.en: : Me? Of course. What’s the matter?
lines.zh: : 问我？当然可以。怎么了？

lines.en: : Touka’s bed-
lines.zh: : Touka 的床——

lines.en: : What about Touka’s bed?!
lines.zh: : Touka 的床怎么了？！

lines.en: : Touka’s bed? You mean the one with rapid sleep technology? What about it?
lines.zh: : Touka 的床？你是说那张带急速入睡科技的床？它怎么了？

lines.en: : Nothing. You actually just answered it. Thank you, Tsubasa.
lines.zh: : 没什么。你其实已经回答了。谢谢你，Tsubasa。

lines.en: : I’m confused. But, that often is the case when it comes to communicating with people in the outside world.
lines.zh: : 我有点困惑。不过，在和外界的人交流这件事上，我常常如此。

lines.en: scene welcometoxmastwo13
: Anyway, do enjoy your Christmas together. I’ll be right down the hall if either of you need me.
lines.zh: : 总之，祝你们圣诞快乐。如果你们有谁需要我，我就在走廊那头。

lines.en: : Also, if you hear screaming, please do not tell anyone you saw me here.
lines.zh: : 另外，如果你们听到尖叫声，请千万别告诉任何人你在这里见过我。

lines.en: : Understood. See you later, Tsubasa.
lines.zh: : 明白。回头见，Tsubasa。

lines.en: scene welcometoxmastwo14
Tsubasa makes her way down the hall, leaving Chika and I alone in the lobby.
lines.zh: Tsubasa 沿着走廊走远，把 Chika 和我单独留在了大堂。

lines.en: Instead of pressing forward like I expect her to, though, Chika remains at a distance and awkwardly stares at me, waiting for me to speak.
lines.zh: 然而她并没有像我预想的那样继续往下聊，而是站在远处，别扭地盯着我看，等着我开口。

lines.en: Unfortunately for her, I am very bad at starting conversations, so I kind of just stand there as well.
lines.zh: 对她来说不巧的是，我非常不擅长起话头，所以我也就只能那么站着。

lines.en: : So, uhh...
lines.zh: : 那个，呃……

lines.en: : Heeeeeeeey...
: Why are you being so awkward?
lines.zh: : 你干嘛这么别扭？

lines.en: : I’m sorry. I’m just redirecting every single impulse in my body away from kissing you and it’s making things really hard for me.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我只是把身体里每一股冲动都从“吻你”这件事上强行转开，这让我现在很难受。

lines.en: : You know, Chinami said something to me a little while ago about you not getting enough sleep lately. Is that because of me? Because of what I said about slowing down?
lines.zh: : 对了，Chinami 前阵子跟我提过一句，说你最近睡眠不太够。是因为我吗？因为我说的那句“慢下来”？

lines.en: scene welcometoxmastwo15
: That little-
lines.zh: : 那小——

lines.en: : How does Chinami keep finding time to tell you the only things I don’t want her to tell you?
lines.zh: : Chinami 到底是怎么每次都能抽出时间，专挑我最不想让她说的那些事告诉你的？

lines.en: : Just answer the question, Chika.
lines.zh: : 回答问题就好，Chika。

lines.en: scene welcometoxmastwo16
: Yeah...it’s true.
lines.zh: : 嗯……是真的。

lines.en: : It’s not your fault, though. Just trying to like, reset my brain and stuff.
lines.zh: : 不过不是你的错。只是想，怎么说呢，让我的脑子重置一下之类的。

lines.en: : If only love was like...some kind of knob you could just turn down whenever you wanted.
lines.zh: : 要是爱情能像……某种旋钮，你想调小的时候随手一转就好了。

lines.en: : I feel like I’m stuck on max settings all the time, and it’s kind of driving me crazy.
lines.zh: : 我感觉自己像是被永远卡在最高档，这快把我逼疯了。

lines.en: scene welcometoxmastwo14
: Please don’t worry about me tonight, though. I already made a promise to myself to give you as much distance as possible.
lines.zh: : 不过今晚别为我担心。我已经对自己承诺过，要给你尽可能多的距离。

lines.en: : This way, even if people did think there was something going on between us, they’ll think it’s over tonight.
lines.zh: : 这样一来，就算别人真觉得我们之间有点什么，他们也会觉得今晚就结束了。

lines.en: : But are {i}you{/i} going to be okay with that?
lines.zh: : 但那样{i}你{/i}真的受得了吗？

lines.en: scene welcometoxmastwo17
: Absolutely.
lines.zh: : 当然。

lines.en: : I’m stronger than I look, Sensei. I’ve dealt with my dad leaving...my mom dying...taking care of Chinami all by myself...tons of stuff!
lines.zh: : 我比看上去要坚强，老师。我爸离家出走……我妈去世……独自一人照顾 Chinami……多少事我都挺过来了！

lines.en: : Staying away from my boyfriend should be a walk in the park for someone like me!
lines.zh: : 对我这样的人而言，离男朋友远一点简直就是散步那么轻松！

lines.en: : Well, on that note, I’m going to go find something to do with this stuffed animal so I don’t have to hold it all night.
lines.zh: : 行，那话说回来，我得去找个地方安置这只毛绒玩具，免得整晚都得抱着它。

lines.en: : Also, please try to sleep more. I know {i}me{/i} being the one to say that might feel like a slap in the face since I’m the one who caused it, but-
lines.zh: : 还有，请你尽量多睡点。我知道这话由{i}我{/i}来说可能像是一巴掌扇在你脸上，毕竟就是我害的，不过——

lines.en: scene welcometoxmastwo18
: I’m fine. Don’t worry about me, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我没事。别担心我，老师。

lines.en: : Buuuuuut...you could maybe make me feel a {i}little{/i} bit better if you tell me you love me before going upstairs?
lines.zh: : 但————是……你要是上楼前能跟我说一句你爱我，或许能让我好受{i}一点{/i}？

lines.en: : I think that might help hold me over a little.
lines.zh: : 我觉得那大概能让我多撑一阵子。

lines.en: I sigh to myself, knowing that I basically walked into this by not leaving the second I had an opening-
lines.zh: 我自顾自地叹了口气，心知这基本上是我自己走出来的局面——我本该一有空当就溜走的。

lines.en: But no one is around and...it {i}is{/i} Christmas, so...
lines.zh: 但现在周围没人，而且……今天{i}是{/i}圣诞节，所以……

lines.en: : I love you.
lines.zh: : 我爱你。

lines.en: scene welcometoxmastwo19
: And I love you!
lines.zh: : 我也爱你！

lines.en: : Now go on! Get out of here before I can’t hold back the urges anymore! Go, Sensei! Go!
lines.zh: : 好了快走！趁我还能忍住冲动之前赶紧走！快走，老师！快走！

lines.en: scene black
Without saying anything else, I leave Chika behind and make my way to the elevator.
lines.zh: 我没再说别的，把 Chika 留在原地，朝电梯走去。

lines.en: I got the room number from Ami earlier, so I already know where I’m headed.
lines.zh: 房间号我早先从 Ami 那儿拿到了，所以我已经知道往哪儿走。

lines.en: I feel a little bad for just leaving Chika downstairs like that, but...I mean, I have twenty girls in my class.
lines.zh: 就这么把 Chika 一个人丢在楼下，我心里有点过意不去，不过……怎么说呢，我班上有二十个女生。

lines.en: And even if she says she’ll be staying away from me to the best of her ability, I’m sure I’ll see more of her later.
lines.zh: 而且就算她说会尽力离我远点，我敢肯定待会儿还是会多见到她。

lines.en: if chikalust10 == True:
Like...maybe on some bench outside of the hotel or something.
lines.zh: 比如……在酒店外面某张长椅上之类的。

lines.en: scene welcometoxmastwo20
: Good evening, Sensei. And a very merry Christmas to you as well.
lines.zh: : 晚上好，老师。也祝你圣诞快乐。

lines.en: : Merry Christmas, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 圣诞快乐，老师。

lines.en: : Likewise.
lines.zh: : 同乐。

lines.en: : Here, Touka. Take this.
lines.zh: : 给，Touka。拿着这个。

lines.en: : Take what? What requires taking?
lines.zh: : 拿什么？有什么需要拿的？

lines.en: scene welcometoxmastwo21
: Ah! An adorable plush bear!
lines.zh: : 啊！好可爱的小熊玩偶！

lines.en: : Sensei! Is this a gift for me?!
lines.zh: : 老师！这是给我的礼物吗？！

lines.en: : Nope. I just need you to hold it.
lines.zh: : 不是。我只是需要你帮我拿着。

lines.en: scene welcometoxmastwo22
: Oh. Why, yes. Of course.
lines.zh: : 哦。呃，好的，当然。

lines.en: : I think...we were supposed to wrap our Secret Santa presents, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 老师，我觉得……我们的 Secret Santa 礼物应该是要包起来的……

lines.en: : You know, I’m getting really tired of everyone telling me how to live my life.
lines.zh: : 你们知道吗，我现在真的受够了每个人都在教我怎么过日子。

lines.en: : If I want to put the minimal amount of effort into someone’s gift, I am free to do that.
lines.zh: : 如果我想在某人的礼物上投入最低限度的心思，那也是我的自由。

lines.en: : Okay, but...why are you making Touka hold it?
lines.zh: : 好吧，可是……你为什么让 Touka 拿着它？

lines.en: : Because his entire purpose in life is to torment me, Futaba. It is exactly as I was telling you earlier.
lines.zh: : 因为他这辈子的全部使命就是折磨我，Futaba。就像我之前跟你说的那样。

lines.en: : Is this just what you girls do? Talk down about me while I’m not around?
lines.zh: : 你们女生就是这样吗？趁我不在的时候编排我？

lines.en: scene welcometoxmastwo23
: Pardon me, Sensei, but I had mainly positive things to say about you! Which is quite surprising, may I add, since you seem to have labeled me as some sort of enemy!
lines.zh: : 恕我直言，老师，我说的主要都是关于你的好话！补充一句，这还挺让人意外的，因为你似乎已经把我标记成某种敌人了！

lines.en: : I don’t think you’re an enemy. It’s just easy to take advantage of your kindness.
lines.zh: : 我不觉得你是敌人。只是你的善良太好利用了。

lines.en: : And also very fun.
lines.zh: : 而且非常有乐趣。

lines.en: : But Futaba is {i}very{/i} kind and you never take advantage of her! Is this class warfare?! Is this how your people “eat the rich?!”
lines.zh: : 但是 Futaba {i}非常{/i}善良，你却从来不利用她！这是阶级斗争吗？！你们这些人就是这样“吃掉富人”的？！

lines.en: : Touka, don’t yell or you’re going to startle the bear.
lines.zh: : Touka，别大喊，你会吓到小熊的。

lines.en: scene welcometoxmastwo24
: Oh no! I’m so sorry, little-
lines.zh: : 不好！真对不起，小——

lines.en: scene welcometoxmastwo25
: Wait! You’re doing it again right now! Taking advantage of my kindness!
lines.zh: : 等等！你现在又来了！又在利用我的善良！

lines.en: : I’m...not saying Sensei is in the right here, but...you should have known better than to think a stuffed bear would have feelings, Touka...
lines.zh: : 我……不是说老师做得对，但是……你早该想到毛绒熊是不会有感情的，Touka……

lines.en: scene welcometoxmastwo26
: Technology is advancing quite rapidly, Futaba. And I do not know what sorts of toys the middle class has access to.
lines.zh: : 科技进步得相当快，Futaba。而且我不清楚中产阶级能弄到什么样的玩具。

lines.en: : I don’t think it’s foolish to believe that one day, all little boys and girls will be able to play with stuffed animals that can think and feel just like you and me.
lines.zh: : 我觉得相信“总有一天，所有小男孩小女孩都能和会像你我一样思考、感受的毛绒玩具一起玩”，并不算愚蠢。

lines.en: : I think...that sounds kind of terrifying.
lines.zh: : 我觉得……那听起来有点吓人。

lines.en: : So is this just how you two are spending Christmas? Standing out in the hallway talking about robot uprisings?
lines.zh: : 所以你们俩就是这样过圣诞的？站在走廊里聊机器人起义？

lines.en: scene welcometoxmastwo27
: This is the very first uprising we’ve discussed, actually.
lines.zh: : 其实这是我们讨论过的第一场起义。

lines.en: : We were talking about more...normal stuff before you showed up, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 在你出现之前，我们聊的……其实是更正常的东西，老师……

lines.en: : That is correct. Futaba and I seldom interact with one another and, as it turns out, we have quite a bit in common.
lines.zh: : 没错。Futaba 和我平时很少来往，结果发现我们其实有不少共同点。

lines.en: : Like how you’re the two most well-endowed girls in the class?
lines.zh: : 比如你们俩是班上最有料的两个女生？

lines.en: scene welcometoxmastwo28
: You are a truly horrible man.
lines.zh: : 你真是个糟糕透顶的男人。

lines.en: : Was that really necessary?...
lines.zh: : 有必要说这个吗？……

lines.en: : Don’t tell me Touka’s turned you against me, has she?
lines.zh: : 别告诉我 Touka 已经把你策反了？

lines.en: scene welcometoxmastwo29
: I’m not against you! There’s just more we have in common than...that thing you said we have in common!
lines.zh: : 我没有反对你！只是我们之间的共同点比……你说的那个共同点要多！

lines.en: : Well, I hope you two enjoy hanging out in the hallway and talking about how my only mission in life is tormenting Tamamo.
lines.zh: : 行吧，那祝你们俩继续在走廊里愉快地聊“我人生唯一使命就是折磨 Tamamo”这个话题。

lines.en: scene welcometoxmastwo30
: Touka! And what am I supposed to do with this bear?!
lines.zh: : Touka！那这只熊我该怎么办？！

lines.en: : Just hold onto it until it’s time for the Secret Santa thing.
lines.zh: : 就一直拿着，等到 Secret Santa 环节就行。

lines.en: : But that’s your responsibility!
lines.zh: : 可那是你的责任啊！

lines.en: : Touka, it’s actually customary for a student to hang onto a stuffed animal for the teacher during a class Christmas party. It means that I think you show the most promise in life.
lines.zh: : Touka，在班级圣诞派对上，让学生替老师保管毛绒玩具其实是一种惯例。这意味着我认为你前途最光明。

lines.en: scene welcometoxmastwo31
: Is...Is that so?
lines.zh: : 是……是这样吗？

lines.en: : No, Touka. Please don’t listen to him.
lines.zh: : 不，Touka。别听他的。

lines.en: : I believe in you, Toriko. Please take care of that gift that I will once again remind you is for someone else.
lines.zh: : 我相信你，Toriko。请帮我保管好那份礼物——我再提醒一次，那是给别人的。

lines.en: : Now, if you’ll please excuse me-
lines.zh: : 那么，失陪了——

lines.en: scene welcometoxmastwo32
: Wait, Sensei- I will continue holding onto this bear for you, but could you please do me a favor and see how Yasu is doing?
lines.zh: : 等等，老师——我会继续帮你拿着这只熊的，但你能不能帮我个忙，去看看 Yasu 怎么样了？

lines.en: : I’ve been attempting to have her “roam free” tonight, and I am worried about the effects that this mysterious “karaoke machine” are having on her.
lines.zh: : 我今晚一直在试着让她“自由活动”，我担心那台神秘的“卡拉 OK 机”会对她产生什么影响。

lines.en: : Is...Yasu singing in there?
lines.zh: : Yasu 在里面……唱歌？

lines.en: : She is not. But she has been staring in awe ever since the machine was turned on.
lines.zh: : 没有。但从机器打开的那一刻起，她就一直一脸敬畏地盯着看。

lines.en: : I even attempted to boop her nose, but there was no effect at all.
lines.zh: : 我甚至试过戳一下她的鼻子，结果一点反应都没有。

lines.en: : I’m sure she’s fine, but I’ll make sure to confirm whether or not she’s slipped into a coma for you if that’s all it takes to have you hold that present for the rest of the night.
lines.zh: : 我肯定她没事，但只要你肯替我把那份礼物拿一整晚，我就去帮你确认一下她到底有没有陷入昏迷。

lines.en: : Do you need me to check on your roommate as well, Futaba?
lines.zh: : 需要我也去看看你室友吗，Futaba？

lines.en: : It would {i}probably{/i} be better if you didn’t, actually. Her and Otoha have been...very close ever since last night.
lines.zh: : 其实你{i}最好{/i}别去。她和 Otoha 从昨晚开始就……非常亲密。

lines.en: : Oh yeah?
lines.zh: : 哦是吗？

lines.en: : Yes, but...I don’t think I should really give you any more info than that...
lines.zh: : 是的，不过……我觉得我不该再透露更多了……

lines.en: : Works for me. I’ll just go...hang out with everyone else then, I guess.
lines.zh: : 正合我意。那我就……去跟大家混混吧。

lines.en: : I’ll see you two around. And don’t lose the bear.
lines.zh: : 回头见。别把熊弄丢了。

lines.en: scene black
I make my way into the hotel room only to be bombarded by the sound of loud feedback spilling out of a small karaoke machine placed near the TV.
lines.zh: 我走进酒店房间，迎面就被一阵刺耳的啸叫声淹没——那声音从摆在电视旁的一台小型卡拉 OK 机里倾泻而出。

lines.en: It mixes in with a handful of scattered conversations that I’m unable to discern due to the sheer amount of them happening simultaneously.
lines.zh: 它和好几段零散的对话搅在一起，由于同时进行的人太多，我根本分辨不清。

lines.en: It’s noticeably louder than last year’s party, but I guess that’s to be expected when the student count has nearly doubled.
lines.zh: 明显比去年的派对吵得多，不过学生人数几乎翻了一倍，这也是意料之中。

lines.en: Anyway, a familiar voice takes the place of the feedback and, within a matter of seconds, a new sound fills the room and serves as my cue to begin mingling.
lines.zh: 总之，一个熟悉的声音取代了那阵啸叫，几秒钟之内，新的声响填满了整个房间，也算是给我发出了开始社交的信号。
